effects.display_name: Disappear projectile native cross-dimension type cleanup
effects.actual_behavior: Intrinsic tick first runs native AbstractArrow.tick, then passes current level/projectile XYZ to helper, then inGround discard. ServerLevel helper creates permission4 suppressed NULL command source with no entity and requests exact kill @e[type=arphex:projectile_disappear_invisible]. No distance, owner, UUID, team, limit, success check or fixed lifetime. Exact Vanilla selector proof: type-only does not set worldLimited; EntitySelector.findEntities false branch iterates server.getAllLevels, whose native body returns levels.values. Thus all matching loaded entities across server levels are command recipients, not just this projectile/current world. No damage magnitude/status is inferred from kill. Native arrow payload still runs first; generated static shoot defaults have no external caller.

effects.display_name: Invisible and Ascendant native gravity-free arrow lifecycle
effects.actual_behavior: Each intrinsic tick first runs AbstractArrow.tick, then invokes its flying helper with THIS PROJECTILE (Ascendant also passes XYZ), then discards if inGround. Nonnull projectile independently setNoGravity(true) and queues a captured projectile discard EVERY callback: Invisible200 ticks, Ascendant60. Delivery checks only captured entity current level not client; no alive, owner, velocity, original-level or already-queued recheck. This is a repeated native scheduling request, not one new fixed lifetime from spawn. Ascendant sweep particles are presentation only. Inherited ARROW damage, native owner constructor, collision, defenses and successful-hurt knockback contract reused; no extra hit/status payload or custom team gate. Generated static shoot overloads have no external finite-census direct/captured callers, so their numeric defaults are excluded; active registry/anonymous constructor paths remain separate native producers.

effects.display_name: Miniature Core post-arrow armor/max-health request and stuck control
effects.actual_behavior: Intrinsic onHitEntity runs AbstractArrow.onHitEntity first, then passes hit recipient, THIS projectile and current getOwner to helper without checking parent hurt success. All three must be nonnull. It first server-discards projectile but continues. Living recipient and owner!=recipient: q=INTEGER 15/int((armor+4)/4); if float(q)>maxHealth/100F request float(q), else maxHealth/100F. Preserve nested integer division and greater branch, no invented floor/rounding. Both requests use MOB_PROJECTILE holder plus the ONE-Entity DamageSource constructor receiving OWNER, not this projectile; return ignored. Independently makeStuckInBlock(AIR,Vec3(.25,.05,.25)) after either attempt, with no additional server/team/owner-pet/hurt-success gate. Native inherited arrow request is separate and already happened even when extra helper later rejects null owner. tick runs parent first, then flying helper receives THIS projectile, setNoGravitytrue and queues100 each callback; lambda only current-level server discard; then intrinsic inGround discard. Generated static shoot helpers are uncalled, so their delivery defaults are not active parameter claims.

effects.display_name: Spin projectile native raw velocity lock and cleanup
effects.actual_behavior: Intrinsic tick calls native arrow first, then helper with THIS projectile, then inGround discard. Nonnull projectile queues400 ticks EVERY callback, with current-server-level-only discard at delivery. If raw deltalockx==0, saves ALL current velocity XYZ; otherwise absolute setDeltaMovement from ALL three stored doubles. Zero-X motion therefore keeps recapturing instead of becoming locked. No normalization, constant acceleration, owner, target or hurt-return dependency. setNoGravitytrue; lookAt EYES toward raw previous XYZ, then writes current XYZ to those keys. parti_spin reset16/decrement1 only selects sixteen particle commands: presentation timer/coordinates excluded from scalar candidates. Native arrow damage/owner/collision remain inherited; uncalled static shoot defaults excluded.

effects.display_name: Web Rope native zero-base arrow and local type cleanup
effects.actual_behavior: Two exact live static callers, SilkSlingerItem/TarantulaTetherItem.onUseTick, require server Level and ServerPlayer; findAmmo checks held projectile first then inventory.items for item identity WebRope.PROJECTILE_ITEM (native InvisibleDetectorBlock). Instabuild OR ammo object!=ItemStack.EMPTY admits DEFAULT shoot(world,Living,Random). It forwards power7,damage0,knockback0; full helper constructs with Living shooter/native owner/null weapon, shoot(viewVector(1),power*2,inaccuracy0),silenttrue,criticalfalse,baseDamage0,knockback0,addFreshEntity. Thus this actual producer uses velocity14 and zero native base damage/knockback; no positive knockback/burn/status is inferred. Instabuild sets pickupCREATIVE_ONLY; otherwise native ammo hurtAndBreak1 if damageable/serverlevel or shrink1. Within server-player branch releaseUsingItem runs even when ammo admission skipped; full item use/release families remain queued. Intrinsic tick runs native parent first, then server helper NULL entity permission4 source at projectile XYZ requests exact kill @e[type=arphex:projectile_web_rope,distance=..50], then inGround discard. Vanilla distance handler sets worldLimited, so recipients are matching loaded types within50 in command current level, including this/others with no owner/team filter. Request is independent of hurt result/command success. Uncalled pull-power and Living/target overloads are excluded; their aim1.1/arc.2/inaccuracy12 are not this delivery.
